design_philosophy: Dense operations index with global filters, status summaries, and a primary project table.
css_layout_rules: Mobile first. Use a single column shell below 768px. At 1024px, switch to grid-template-columns: 232px minmax(0, 1fr). Summary strip uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)). Project table uses stable columns and horizontal overflow on small screens.
